chapter: Harlem musicians and the road with Armstrong
title: Coming and going with Russell, then five years with Armstrong
summary: He left and rejoined Russell freely, and from 1935 to 1940 worked with Armstrong, finally unable to take the hard work.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: With Russell, you went in and out of there several
times. And you could more or less come and go as you pleased, right?
Yeah. I did. He was always glad when I come back. And usually I was glad to get back, too. They say the grass is always greener on the other side of the street -- until you get there.
At this point, Louis must have returned, because didn't he end up fronting Russell's band and going out on the road?

In 1935. In 1935 he was (?). Because I worked with him from 1935 to '40. Then I couldn't take it no longer. Five years of hard work. The man was... He had too much stamina for me. And I couldn't take it no more.
